outcome: early-onset hypertension disorders of pregnancy (<34 weeks)
late-onset hypertension disorders of pregnancy (>=34 weeks)
cohort: The study included 257 Japanese women with singleton pregnancies and a prepregnancy BMI >= 30.0 kg/m2 who gave birth between 2013 and 2020 at Ohta Nishinouchi Hospital.
finding: Gestational weight gain during pregnancy increased the risk of early-onset and overall hypertension disorders of pregnancy among primiparas, with an optimal gestational weight gain for reducing HDP recommended to be under 3.85 kg.
